#			
#		#MODJAM2024
#
#######################################################
#
#	Thank you for your interest in participating in #MODJAM2024! DO NOT EDIT ANY FILES IN THIS PACKAGE. DO NOT INCLUDE ANY OF THESE FILES IN
#	YOUR FINAL SUBMISSION. This has been distributed to you so that you have examples of how to spawn Legendary Leaders, and for 
#	testing purposes.
#
#	All mod files, flags, and events must follow the format: MODABBREVIATION_type.txt. Your mod abbreviation should be shorter than the word
#	abbreviation, and the type is just "events" "buildings" etc. Specific flags and other details can be found in the full list of rules on Discord.
#
#	Your final mod submission must include:
#		One (1) Legendary Leader
#		Two (2) or more flavor events that occur after the leader has been hired
#		One (1) or more events that lead to the option to recruit the Legendary Leader
#		One (1) or more unique Solar System Initializer(s) where the event(s) to recruit the Legendary Leader begin. These events can triggered from an on_survey on_action (like in the modder package), but the events leading to the recruitment of your leader can also be more involved
#		One (1) scripted_effect that will spawn your legendary leader's solar_system_initializer (to be fired from solar_system scope)
#
#	Please review the full rules of the Mod Jam on the discord. You will need to comply with *all* of those rules in order to 
#	have an accepted final submission.
#
#	Submissions must be feature complete by January 4th. There will then be 5 days where you can bug fix and otherwise polish your Submission.
#	*Final Submissions due on January 9th, 2024* for release on January 11th, 2024.
#
#	New to Modding? Here's a few tips:
#		* Use Visual Studio Code and install the CWTools extension
#		* in Documents/Paradox Interactive/Stellaris/logs/script_documentation you can find a list of 
#		triggers, scopes, effects and modifiers that are supported by the game
#		* You can find information on Modding Stellaris on the Stellaris Wiki: https://stellaris.paradoxwikis.com/Modding
#		* The Stellaris Modding Den on Discord is a great resource Modders who are starting out with 
#		Stellaris Modding: https://discord.gg/nx29SvPxhS
#		* Starting a local repository will help you make risk-free changes to your Submission, as long as you commit often. Repositories
#		will save versions of your files that you can "roll back" to if you make changes that do not work. You can use Git or a more visual
#		program like Gitkraken. https://help.gitkraken.com/gitkraken-client/how-to-install/
#		* There are many experienced modders in this year's Mod Jam, so feel free to ask questions in the #Modjam-help forum on the Stellaris Discord
# 		if you get stuck!
#
#	Thanks again for your interest in #MODJAM2024, best of luck to all Modders!
#		
#	MrFreake,
#	Community Specialist,
#	Stellaris
